about: Leonida Legend is a self-contained GTA VI trophy companion: the official PlayStation names, descriptions and grades are reproduced for reference, while every guide, roadmap note and tip is original writing for this entry. Claims are backed by the sources cited on each trophy, chiefly PlayStation.Blog's published list, PowerPyx, PSNProfiles, Exophase and PlayStationTrophies.org.

meta.title: GTA VI - Leonida Legend trophy guide and tracker
meta.note: Official names, descriptions and grades are reproduced as PlayStation publishes them; guides are original text written for this entry with named sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the sum of the list, not a separate task. Clear the 54 bronze, silver and gold entries in the order of the roadmap, then confirm the checklist is fully ticked; the game awards this automatically when the last one lands. Keep an export of your progress before the final mission so nothing is lost if you change consoles.
sources: PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
tips: Finish every other trophy on the checklist.
Use the Export button to keep a backup of your ticks.
The platinum unlocks automatically with the 54th trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, when the story offers it after the prologue; it is the tutorial job and cannot be skipped. PowerPyx places it before the Chapter 1 timer, so clear it first and save the resulting autosave.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Start a new story playthrough.
Play Gone Fishing in the opening sequence; follow the on-screen objectives.
Do not abandon the mission before the completion screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 is a linear block of story missions; the trophy arrives with the chapter-complete card. Nothing inside the chapter is a one-time choice, so you can replay missions later or use chapter select, as PSNProfiles notes for story chapters.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Continue the main story until the Chapter 1 banner appears.
Finish every mission flagged as Chapter 1 in the mission log.
The trophy pops with the chapter-complete card.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 2's mission strand to its chapter-complete card. Exophase lists this as a hidden chapter trophy, so the name stays masked on PlayStation until it unlocks; use the spoiler switch here if you are playing blind.
sources: Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Work the Chapter 2 missions in the order the journal gives them.
Watch for the chapter-complete card; the trophy unlocks there.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 mission arc. PlayStationTrophies groups chapter trophies as unmissable story progress, so no special setup is needed; simply stay on the critical path until the chapter closes.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Play the Chapter 3 missions from the journal.
Finish the closing mission of the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so make a manual save here: PowerPyx recommends a pre-finale save for post-game cleanup and for anything the finale changes.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Play through the Chapter 4 missions.
Create a manual save before starting the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold finale trophy is awarded for completing the final mission of the story. Choose your ending as you like, then keep the post-game save: free roam continues and every collectible, activity and strand remains available afterwards, per the cited roadmaps.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Make a manual save at the end of Chapter 4.
Play the final mission to the credits.
Keep the completed save for the rest of the roadmap.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named, one-off job on the critical path; the trophy unlocks on the mission-complete screen. If you replay it from the mission log, PSNProfiles notes the replay still counts, so a failed attempt costs nothing.
sources: Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Find Breakfast Run in the story journal and launch it.
Play to the mission-complete screen.
Replay from the journal if you fail; the trophy still counts.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold: reach 100% Completion. Track the in-game completion percentage, not just this checklist: it rolls up story, strands, stunts, activities, collectibles, purchases and properties. Work the roadmap stages in order and use the in-game stat page to find whichever category is still short.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
tips: Open the in-game completion/stat page and note the categories below 100%.
Clear the remaining categories using the roadmap stages.
Check the percentage after each category; the trophy unlocks at 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 Stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps and stunt events both feed the counter, so vary your route: pick a fast bike, sweep the marked stunt ramps district by district, and re-check the in-game counter after each sweep. The accumulation is permanent and cannot be lost.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
tips: Use a fast bike or car and a map of marked stunt ramps.
Clear ramps district by district, repeating ones the counter still credits.
Watch the 250/250 counter, not an estimate.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of every activity type at least once, not win them. Go through the activities list (races, drones, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest) and tick each off as you sample it; PlayStationTrophies lists this as a sampler trophy, so a loss still counts.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
tips: Open the in-game activities list.
Try each distinct type once; finishing is enough, winning is not required.
Use the checklist here to record which types you have sampled.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The official list carries the count of 42; work one weapon station at a time, retry until the gold threshold is shown as beaten, then move on. Accuracy and time targets are displayed before each challenge.
sources: PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
tips: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge board.
Complete all 42 challenges to gold, retrying any that fall short.
Use the counter in the guide: 42 golds total.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Each venue has its own win flag, so keep a venue-by-venue list: enter the race, take first place, then travel to the next marker. PowerPyx treats these as repeatable activities, so a loss just means another attempt.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
tips: Track every Top Fun location on the map.
Win the drone race at each one; retry freely.
Tick a location only once the win screen appears.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, not 20 wins of the same event. The word different is the whole requirement: keep a list of the 20 distinct race events you have taken first in, then move to a new marker each time.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Race only at markers you have not won before.
Take first place and record the event name.
Stop at 20 distinct wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing side-event, accept the challenge and outscore him; the scoreboard at the end decides it, so retry if he wins. Exophase lists this as a standalone activity, unconnected to the story.
sources: Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Locate Cal's fishing challenge marker.
Win the challenge against Cal on the final scoreboard.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Pick whichever cabinet you find first and play it through to its completion screen; a single completed cabinet is all the description asks for.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Find an arcade cabinet in free roam.
Play one game through to its completion screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Andy. Stranger strands unfold over several jobs for the same character; keep accepting Andy's markers until the strand's last mission appears, then complete it. Save after each job so a failure does not cost progress.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Accept every mission Andy offers, in order.
Complete the strand's final mission.
Treat this as missable: finish the strand while its markers are available.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. His strand is a chain of jobs like the other stranger arcs; work through each marker until the finale unlocks. The cited roadmaps advise finishing character strands during the story rather than leaving them for the end.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Work Kenton's missions in sequence.
Finish the last mission of his strand while it is available.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: See Billy's strand through to its final mission. Because this is a named character arc with a finale, missing an early job can block the strand; tick each mission here as you go, and do not leave Billy until after the finale without checking his markers.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Start Billy's first job and follow the chain.
Complete the final mission of the strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. A strand means the whole chain for one character, counted through its closing job; spread them across districts so you are not hunting one region at a time. Strands remain available after the story, but the missable flag here reflects that some are tied to a character's availability window.
sources: PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
tips: Pick 8 distinct stranger characters with mission chains.
Finish each chain to its final job.
Count strands, not individual missions.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Work his jobs in order until the strand closes; replay from the journal if a job fails, as with the other character arcs.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Accept Randy's jobs in sequence.
Finish the strand's final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. His chain behaves like the other stranger strands: each job unlocks the next, so keep returning until the finale appears, then clear it.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Follow Tyrone's mission chain to the end.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. This is a location set: use the map markers, sit through the meditation at each spot, and tick it off here so you never revisit the same one twice. Spots stay available after the credits, so nothing here is missable.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
tips: Reveal or mark every meditation spot on the map.
Complete the meditation interaction at each spot.
Tick each spot in this tracker.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunting job, follow the marked area and bring down the specific animal the mission names; the mission-complete confirmation is what counts, not a generic kill.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Accept Bret's hunting request.
Track and take down the unique animal the mission marks.
Return or confirm the kill to close the job.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are a set-based collectible: check the in-game collection menu for which cards you hold, then hunt only the missing cards of three sets rather than sweeping randomly. This is a count trophy (3 sets), so stop once three are complete.
sources: PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
tips: Open the card collection menu and list the sets.
Collect the missing cards for three sets.
Confirm three complete sets in the menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. This is the big location counter: 100 distinct spots, one interaction each. Work district by district with a map and tick the count here; repeats of the same location do not advance the counter.
sources: PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
tips: Find the WAiNK location markers across Leonida.
Interact at 100 distinct locations.
Track the running count in the in-game stats.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the repeatable open-world objectives shown on the map; any 50 count, so choose short ones first and check the challenge counter after each batch.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Browse the challenge markers on the map.
Clear 50 challenges in total; mix types for variety.
Verify the counter reaches 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level while your partner is with you, keep them in the group, then break the search and survive until the stars clear. If your partner is dismissed, the attempt will not register.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Make sure your partner is accompanying you.
Raise the Wanted Level to 4 stars.
Evade the search until the stars clear, with the partner still present.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level between them. Plan a route of three close shops before starting: the heat must stay active from the first robbery to the third. A partner must be present for the whole chain.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Bring your partner and pick three nearby shops.
Rob shop 1, keep the Wanted Level alive.
Rob shops 2 and 3 before the heat clears.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery means entering or driving each vehicle type once; use traffic, parked cars, dealerships and garages to fill out the list, and tick the counter here. A repeat model does not add to the total.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Enter or drive new vehicle models as you travel.
Use dealerships and garages for rare models.
Check the 100-vehicle counter.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of at least five hostile targets, trigger the ability and chain the kills inside its window; crowd a police response or a gang compound rather than spreading the attempt across separate activations.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PSNProfiles - GTA VI trophy guide: https://psnprofiles.com/guides
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Find or provoke a group of 5+ enemies.
Activate Combat Focus once.
Down all five before the ability ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is a secured site, so the requirement is the escape after you get inside: reach the compound, trigger the alert, then leave the grounds without being stopped. PlayStationTrophies flags scene-specific trophies like this as ones to do while the location is accessible.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI guide: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/guide/
PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
PlayStation official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation.Blog, 2026)
tips: Get onto the VCIA grounds.
Trigger the 'unscheduled departure' sequence.
Escape the compound to the mission-complete state.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. This hidden trophy is tied to a tank (Rhino) set-piece: get hold of a Rhino, survive the heat that comes with it and complete the sequence the game flags. Hidden trophies keep their text masked until unlocked; use the spoiler switch if you want to go in blind.
sources: Exophase - GTA VI PS5 trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/gta-vi-ps5/trophies/

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Scout the store, enter quietly and leave before any alarm or witness meter fills. If a camera or guard spots you, restart the robbery rather than finishing a detected attempt.

Complete the robbery with no detection.
Escape cleanly; retry if spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate vault jobs, each finished with a successful getaway; tick one here after every clean escape so you do not double-count an attempt that ended in a bust.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Catch a truck on its route, take the cargo and lose the resulting heat. One successful robbery-and-escape is enough; a failed getaway means trying again with the next truck.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Fog-of-war style discovery: drive or fly the whole map until every district reads as explored. Work grid by grid from the coast inland, and check the map percentage at the end of each strip.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.powerpyx.com/grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

Travel each region until it reveals.
Finish with the whole map explored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There is one operation per gang, so list the gangs first, hit one site each and tick it here; missing a gang means the trophy stays locked even after several robberies.

Rob one operation per gang.
Confirm every gang is ticked.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A hidden, scene-flavoured trophy: find the oceanfront bar interaction on Ocean Beach and sit through the drink with the view. Hidden trophies mask their text on PlayStation until earned, so the spoiler toggle can keep this one covered.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Enter a showroom and drive out through the glass rather than using the door; the description asks for the destructive exit, so a careful exit will not count.

Drive out through the showroom glazing.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the bowling alley and complete the follow-through interaction the game flags; it is an activity visit like the arcade, not a score target.

Play the frame and complete the follow-through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This hidden trophy is tied to the two-lead partnership: keep your partner with you for the flagged activity and complete it together. If the partner is absent, redo the scene.

Complete the flagged partnership activity together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). A story-choice trophy: the description points to decisions made during the campaign. Make sure to play through the decision scenes rather than skipping them, and keep a save before the choice if you want to see both outcomes.

Play the choice scenes through without skipping.
Keep the outcome save; replay from the earlier save if you want the other branch.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at a retry: attempt the flagged encounter or challenge, fail or fall short once, then succeed on the second go. Keep the same session so the attempt counter stays with you.

Return for the second attempt and complete it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden secret trophy tied to a scripted world event. Keep exploring during different times of day and follow any unusual encounter to its end; hidden events like this are easy to walk away from, so finish the scene when you find it.

When a strange scripted event starts, stay with it to its conclusion.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Combine a melee weapon with a vehicle: lean out during a drive-by and knock targets over with the melee attack rather than a firearm. Aim for a slow-moving cluster of targets so one pass is enough.

Knock down the flagged number of targets in the pass.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. This is a cumulative money counter: run the laundering loop with your contacts repeatedly and bank each payout, rather than spending the proceeds until the $250,000 total is reached.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Cumulative spend, not a balance: buy vehicles, clothes, weapons and upgrades from a range of shop types. The tracker's money stage is a good place to log each big purchase.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Properties are a finite buy-list: check the property map, buy each garage as funds allow, then compare the owned list with the for-sale markers to catch the last one.

Buy each garage property in turn.
Confirm no garage markers remain for sale.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive or acquire ten distinct vehicles and register each one in the app; the counter is per vehicle, so repeating the same one will not help. Tick the app's list as you go.
